## unselectableItemCommands() function

The commands of a manifest that would be offered as an operation but cannot select the item they act on, in declaration order, each once.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function unselectableItemCommands(manifest: AppManifest): UnselectableItemCommand[]
```

**Returns:**

[UnselectableItemCommand](./core.unselectableitemcommand.md)<!-- -->\[\]

One entry per such command; empty when every command qualifies.

## Remarks

Only a command with a route is considered: a command or resource marked unsupported is offered nowhere, so it is never refused. A known gap (`knownItemSelectionGap`<!-- -->) is not refused either.
